decisions.reason: The charting bundle has not been visible since 2018, but it is a low-cost extension of the core map.apps platform and is likely maintained within regular releases, so there is no clear shortfall that would force problemistic search.

VueTOC was a narrow component that has disappeared from the website since its launch news, which suggests it fell short of aspirations or was absorbed into other products, so its resources are better redirected to the core platform.

Mobile field data capture meets a lasting core need of public and utility customers, so despite low recent visibility its expected performance stays near aspiration and slack allows the firm to carry it.

With the hierarchical search plugin already withdrawn and this search extension not visible since 2018, it appears redundant within the web map offer, and consolidating search functions frees resources for new development.
